detailed_descriptions.en: ASTROBOTANICA™ is a science-driven exploration adventure set on prehistoric Earth. You’re Xel - an alien botanist stranded on a hostile primeval world while searching for rare plant species capable of saving your dying home planet. Ancient Earth is beautiful, mysterious, and toxic to your physiology. To survive, you must study the planet’s ecosystems, discover powerful prehistoric flora, and master the art of botanical experimentation. Scan unfamiliar plants, gather rare ingredients, and combine their properties to create tonics that restore health, energy, and CO₂. Learn how different species interact, uncover powerful botanical aspects, and develop new ways to adapt to Earth’s dangerous atmosphere. Journey through tropical coastline, rocky cliffs, lush jungles and hidden caves filled with unique plant habitats, environmental mysteries, and extinct wildlife. Discover forgotten locations, unlock new regions, and uncover pathways hidden behind ancient puzzles. Encounter a lone Neanderthal surviving in the prehistoric wilderness. Heal his ailments using handcrafted botanical remedies and uncover the secrets surrounding his mysterious totem. Earth’s atmosphere is deadly to Xel. Use your crashed ship as a mobile research base - store energy, power advanced systems, generate CO₂, and recharge your equipment while preparing for deeper expeditions into the unknown. detailed_descriptions_html.en:
ASTROBOTANICA™ is a science-driven exploration adventure set on prehistoric Earth. You’re Xel - an alien botanist stranded on a hostile primeval world while searching for rare plant species capable of saving your dying home planet. Ancient Earth is beautiful, mysterious, and toxic to your physiology. To survive, you must study the planet’s ecosystems, discover powerful prehistoric flora, and master the art of botanical experimentation.

Scan unfamiliar plants, gather rare ingredients, and combine their properties to create tonics that restore health, energy, and CO₂. Learn how different species interact, uncover powerful botanical aspects, and develop new ways to adapt to Earth’s dangerous atmosphere.

Journey through tropical coastline, rocky cliffs, lush jungles and hidden caves filled with unique plant habitats, environmental mysteries, and extinct wildlife. Discover forgotten locations, unlock new regions, and uncover pathways hidden behind ancient puzzles.

Encounter a lone Neanderthal surviving in the prehistoric wilderness. Heal his ailments using handcrafted botanical remedies and uncover the secrets surrounding his mysterious totem.

Earth’s atmosphere is deadly to Xel. Use your crashed ship as a mobile research base - store energy, power advanced systems, generate CO₂, and recharge your equipment while preparing for deeper expeditions into the unknown.

  • Discover and study prehistoric plant species

  • Create experimental tonics

  • Explore interconnected biomes filled with secrets and environmental puzzles

  • Manage energy and CO₂ using alien technology and plant science

  • Explore a prehistoric world inhabited by extinct creatures
